'''Beehives''' are [[Player base|base]] structures used for producing [[Honey]]. 

The [[Queen Bee]] requires to craft a Beehives can be found by destroying [[Bee Nest]]s.

== Notes ==
The bees have a variety of flavor text. During night and in rainy weather, the flavor text always says, "The bees are sleeping."

During the day, the flavor text says, "The bees are happy." or "The bees need more room." depending on the conditions. The factor on happiness is that the beehive has less than 60% [[cover]] and is placed in a compatible biome (Meadows, Black Forest, and Plains).

* A beehive takes approximately 20 minutes in real time to produce one [[Honey]].
* A beehive can fill up to four [[Honey]] at a time.

'''Stone Pile''' is a buildable structure that is used to store [[Stone]] or simply decorate a homestead.

Storing extra stones using stone piles is generally less space-efficient than using chests. However, it is possible to tightly pack stone piles in the same area, provided that the stone piles all have the same orientation, and are placed on a flat surface like a [[Stone Floor 2x2|stone floor]]. This results in a "hyper dense" stone pile which is highly space-efficient.

'''Stakewall''' is a buildable structure. Unlike other Wooden building parts, Stakewalls do not deteriorate due to rain, making them perfect for perimeter walls around player settlements.

Stakewalls do not damage [[creatures]] that come into contact with them. See [[Stakes]] for structures that deal damage to creatures.

==Note==
* A [[Blob]] can just barely manage to jump over a Stakewall on level ground. When building in areas such as the Swamp, where Blobs are common, it is thus wise to put Stakewalls on a slight elevation so that Blobs cannot get past them.

== Notes ==
* Sharp stakes must be built on dirt.

'''Ivy''' is a plant added in the Bog Witch update that can be planted with the [[Ivy Seeds]] using the [[Cultivator]]. Its only purpose is decorative; it can climb structures when planted, which makes it useful for decorating buildings. Unlike [[Ashvine]], it never grows [[Vineberry Cluster]]s or any other harvestable item.

Each Ivy costs one [[Ivy Seeds]] to plant. The planted sapling (ID VineGreen_sapling) grows into the full plant (ID VineGreen).

After the ivy has spread to a surface, no connection to cultivated soil is necessary. This means the player can use a temporary support surface to spread ivy to second story walls. Ivy does not require any connection to the ground to continue to grow.

== Growing ==
The sapling must be planted on cultivated ground. It grows into ivy after 200 to 300 seconds, as long as all of the following are true:
* It is in the [[Meadows]], [[Black Forest]], [[Swamp]], [[Plains]], [[Mistlands]] or [[Ocean]]. It cannot grow in the [[Ashlands]]. In the [[Mountain]] and [[Deep North]] it is too cold, unless it is inside the shield of a [[Shield Generator]].
* There is no roof or other object above it.
* Nothing solid, including the wall it will climb and other healthy plants, is within 0.5 meters of it, and no ivy or other vine is within 1.8 meters.
* A building piece is within 1.8 meters for it to cling to.

The grown ivy attaches to the nearest building piece and spreads sideways and upward across it, but never downward. Each ivy segment needs a solid surface behind it and breaks if that surface is removed. Each segment has 30 health.
